questions.prompt: A train leaves at 2:15 pm and arrives 3 hours and 45 minutes later. What time does it arrive? Show the arithmetic.
All roses are flowers. Some flowers fade quickly. Does it follow that some roses fade quickly? Explain briefly.
questions.gold: No. The premise says some flowers fade quickly, but roses may be a subset of flowers that do not fade quickly. No valid conclusion.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Iceland, and roughly what is its population?
A baker has 12 eggs. Each cake needs 3 eggs. How many cakes can she bake, and how many eggs are left over?
Choose the correct word: 'The rain had a big ___ on the match.' (affect / effect)
A glass of water is left in a freezer overnight. The water freezes. Did the temperature of the water drop or stay the same while it was freezing? Explain in one sentence.
questions.gold: Temperature stays at 0 C (freezing point) while the phase change happens; it drops after all ice forms.

questions.prompt: Summarize in one or two sentences: A study found that adults who slept 6 hours or less each night had a 12% higher risk of early death than those who slept 7 to 8 hours. The link remained after adjusting for age, sex, and lifestyle factors, so the authors say sleep duration itself matters, not just health problems.
questions.gold: Sleeping 6 hours or less was linked to a 12% higher early-death risk than 7-8 hours, even after adjusting for lifestyle and health factors, so the authors conclude short sleep itself matters.

questions.prompt: Sara has $10. She buys 3 apples at $1.50 each and a juice for $2. How much money does she have left?
How many minutes are in 2.5 hours? Show the arithmetic.
Evaluate: 6 + 4 x 5 - 3 squared. Show the order of operations you used.
A fair coin is flipped 3 times. What is the probability of getting heads all three times?
What is two-thirds of 48?
Complete the analogy: physician is to stethoscope as carpenter is to ____.
What is the largest country in the world by land area?
What is the capital city of Australia?
Why do ice cubes float in water? Explain in one or two sentences.
questions.gold: Ice is less dense than liquid water because water expands as it freezes, so the same mass takes up more volume.

questions.prompt: All cats are mammals. All tigers are mammals. Does it follow that all cats are tigers? Explain briefly.
questions.gold: No. Sharing the class 'mammals' does not imply the two groups are the same or overlap.

questions.prompt: You walk 3 km north, 4 km east, then 3 km south. How far are you from your starting point?
A shirt costs $80. It is discounted 25%. What is the sale price?
Fill in the blank with 'fewer' or 'less': 'There were ___ people at the park today.'
What is the next number in the series: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, __?
If it is raining, then the ground is wet. The ground is wet. Does it follow that it is raining? Explain briefly.
questions.gold: No. This is the valid-in-reverse error (affirming the consequent); a wet lawn or hose could also cause it.

questions.prompt: How many milliliters are in 2 liters?
Which of these is a renewable energy source: coal, natural gas, solar, or uranium?
Three friends split a 45-pound bill equally. How much does each pay?
It is 7:45 pm. What time will it be in 40 minutes?
What is the main function of red blood cells in the human body? Answer in one sentence.
questions.gold: They carry oxygen from the lungs to the body's tissues.

questions.prompt: A shop recorded daily sales: Mon 12, Tue 9, Wed 15, Thu 9, Fri 20. Which day(s) had the lowest sales, and what number?
Who wrote the play 'Romeo and Juliet'?
